purpose: Document Padrauna's official Uttar Pradesh cadastral service, current viewer/API inspection, bounded anonymous requests, and the separation between tehsil registry evidence and city parcel geometry.
assessment: The official UP Bhunaksha viewer is reachable anonymously and its current JavaScript identifies a public `/bhunakshaserver` API. Kushinagar district 189 and Padrauna tehsil 00955 resolve correctly; village-level metadata and EPSG:32644 extents were returned for control villages. No safe parcel polygon/native parcel ID for the urban Padrauna city was verified, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Uttar Pradesh Revenue Board/UP Bhulekh service and the Padrauna-specific official digitization dashboard, plus successful current viewer resolution for district and tehsil. This establishes an official local/tehsil registry service, not citywide geometry completeness.

attempts: Loaded the official UP Bhunaksha viewer HTML over TLS and inspected the current JavaScript/configuration; it identifies https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and public map-info, level, and plot routes.
Resolved level labels: District, Tehsil, Village.
Resolved district 189 to Kushinagar and tehsil 00955 to Padrauna via the public level-value API.
Fetched the Padrauna tehsil village list anonymously; it returned rural revenue-village values, with no urban Padrauna city value in that response.
Fetched bounded control-village map extents for village codes 188479, 188555, and 188694; responses returned EPSG:32644 and native gisCode values, but no parcel geometry was requested or retained.
Probed an unavailable tehsil/urban extent and received a zero extent; this was recorded as a route limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
Reviewed the official Padrauna-specific map-digitization dashboard, which reports village-level scanning/linkage status.
Performed separate English and Hindi first-party discovery queries and recorded actual result URLs.
Did not request owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or other unsafe fields; did not log in, bypass CAPTCHA/Cloudflare, or disable TLS verification; did not shift the WUP point.
No sample GeoJSON was created because no full city parcel polygon and safe native parcel identity were independently verified.
